run_estop_nogui_cli: run the estop program with curses terminal interface to control robot emergency stop
create_estop_nogui_instance: create an EstopNoGui instance with a bosdyn estop client and timeout in seconds
stop_robot_with_estop: call stop on an EstopNoGui instance to immediately trigger the robot emergency stop
allow_robot_movement: call allow on an EstopNoGui instance to release the emergency stop and allow robot movement
settle_then_cut_estop: call settle_then_cut on an EstopNoGui instance to let the robot settle before cutting estop
